title: Roasted crust pie

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Roasted crust pie is an Ashlands-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Uncooked roasted crust pie is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 2 Vineberry cluster
• 1 Volture egg
• 4 Barley flour
Roasted crust pie is produced by cooking uncooked roasted crust pie dough in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Roasted crust pie provides the highest stamina gain in the game at 100.
